top_choice_rationale: P001 awards targeted protein degradation as a single part to Crews, Deshaies and Handa, with a citation naming the chemical principle: a small molecule induces a ligase-target ternary complex and destroys the protein catalytically. It covers both the designed PROTAC strand and the cereblon mechanism of glue degraders, and the three-person limit is respected. P002 is a close second, since swapping Handa for Ciulli keeps the part intact but narrows the citation to bifunctional degraders and leaves out the mechanism of the glue strand. P003 shrinks the degrader part to two names and adds base editing, a presentist pairing of two young fields with an unresolved cytidine-deamination priority question, but it still honours a real new principle, so it ranks above no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; physicist at Lund with no tie to Crews, Deshaies, Handa, Ciulli or Liu, and Lund colleagues Somfai and Sparr are not a conflict
